data.location: 1120 N State Street, Chicago, IL (zip not specified)
data.short_description: Lou Malnati's Gold Coast location is closing when its lease expires at end of June. The team plans to open a new Gold Coast location, potentially as early as next year, and will operate an interim offsite kitchen in the neighborhood in the meantime.

data.location: Gold Coast, Chicago, IL (Address not specified)
data.short_description: Lou Malnati's is in lease negotiations for a new Gold Coast storefront to replace the closing location. The new restaurant could open as early as next year.

Wild Eggs, a Louisville, Kentucky-based breakfast and brunch brand, is planning its first Columbus-area location at The Commons at Hamilton Quarter. An official opening date has not been announced; it is expected to open as part of the center's phased tenant rollout.

Riptide Tavern, a Jersey Shore-inspired neighborhood bar, will open at 4388 Main Street in Manayunk, steps from owner Tim Spinner's other restaurant, Taqueria Amor. The 38-seat venue will feature beach memorabilia, a jukebox, crush cocktails, and a no-cell-phone policy.

data.location: 23017 Outer Dr W, Allen Park, MI 48101
data.short_description: A new Noorjahan Indian Cuisine location is planned for 23017 Outer Drive West in Allen Park, at the former Detroit Wing Company space, marking the chain's ninth restaurant. No opening date has been released; the location is now listed on the Michigan Business Registry.

Fat + Flour's Grand Central Market outpost in Downtown Los Angeles is closing after nearly seven years in operation. The bakery's Culver City location at 11739 W. Washington Blvd. will continue to operate.
Pittsburgh-based Milkshake Factory is expanding to The Commons at Hamilton Quarter near New Albany and Gahanna in Columbus. An opening date has not been confirmed.

Mediterranean restaurant Mozaika Mezze is planning a new location at Terminus 100 in Buckhead, at the former Alma Cocina space. Signage indicates the new location will open in the fall; the existing Alpharetta location opened last August.

data.location: Charlotte, NC 28262 (mobile food truck, no fixed address)
data.short_description: Carolina Smash Truck, a Charlotte-area grilled cheese food truck, announced it will permanently close after nine years in business. The owners shared no reason for the closure but thanked their staff and community and hinted at a new venture ahead.

data.status: last day of service is Sunday, June 14th
data.short_description: Fish and Bird Sousaku Izakaya, a Japanese restaurant on Shattuck Avenue in Berkeley, will close on June 14 after a 6.5-year run. The owner cited semi-retirement and a difficult operating environment as reasons for the closure.

data.location: 151 E Welbourne Ave, Winter Park, FL 32789
data.short_description: Cocina 214, a Tex-Mex restaurant in Winter Park that opened in 2011, will close on May 29 as its lease nears expiration on June 1. The building was sold in February 2026 for $5.9 million, and the team was unable to find a suitable relocation site.

data.location: 58 The Esplanade, Toronto, ON M5E 1R2, Canada
data.short_description: Dolly's, a large country music-focused nightlife venue developed by brothers Graham and Dan Hnatiw, is set to open in Toronto at 58 The Esplanade in the former Bier Markt space. The venue is expected to accommodate roughly 700 guests indoors and up to 1,000 with the patio, featuring line dancing, live music, pizza, and batched cocktails.

data.location: 3005 Old Alabama Rd, Johns Creek, GA 30022
data.short_description: Washington, D.C. franchise Toastique is bringing a new location to Johns Creek, to be operated by husband-and-wife team Steve and Randi Rubin. The location will serve gourmet toast, smoothies, superfood bowls, coffee, and cold-pressed juices, operating from 7 a.m. to 5 p.m.

Owners John Feller and Jessica Crawford, behind at-home cocktail kit business Aged & Infused, are opening a cocktail bar called Home Bar at the former Rhine Hall Distillery space on W Fulton Street. No opening date has been announced; the team is awaiting licensing approval and hoping to open around mid-July.

data.location: 1693 Dundas St W, Toronto, ON M6K 1V2, Canada
data.short_description: Chef Kaitlyn Lasagna's Roman-style supplì concept Buon Riso is launching a pop-up residency at Pasta Forever, where she currently works, beginning June 14. Pre-orders are expected to open the Monday before launch, and the business may expand into a recurring Sunday summer residency.

data.status: will not be renewing its long-term lease
data.short_description: Heart Attack Grill, located inside Neonopolis Mall in Downtown Las Vegas, confirmed it will not renew its lease after nearly 15 years in operation. The team cited changes in the Las Vegas dining landscape, rising costs, and evolving dining culture as factors, while hinting at a future new chapter for the brand.

Lighthouse Kitchen and Cafe, a 24-hour cafe inspired by owner Claudia Vazquez's Mexican roots, is opening at 3109 Pacific Ave. in Wildwood. The cafe will grind and brew its own coffee using beans from the owner's family farm in Chiapas, Mexico, and will serve all-day breakfast, brunch, and dinner.

data.location: 301 W Washington St, San Diego, CA 92103
data.short_description: Serafino, an all-day cafe and wine bar, is currently undergoing a full renovation combining two adjacent storefronts into a 3,100-square-foot space in San Diego's Mission Hills neighborhood. Co-founders David Cross and Rebeca Cross are leading the project alongside COO Michael Di Carlo and GM Amanda Sarich, with a focus on building a diverse team including individuals of all abilities.

data.status: expected to open in early June
data.short_description: Fresh & Feta, a fast-casual Mediterranean concept from Habibi Grill owner Tarek Albast, is set to open inside Little Grand Market at Grandview Crossing in early June. The menu will feature customizable bowls, wraps, salads, and sides including hummus, baba ganoush, and fried cauliflower.

data.location: 3205 Washington Blvd, Marina Del Rey, CA 90292
data.status: in the early stages of development
data.short_description: Pita Cafe is opening a new location at 3205 Washington Blvd in Marina del Rey, confirmed by owner Ramin Nouri, with an exact opening timeline still forthcoming. The concept offers Mediterranean cuisine including kabobs, pita wraps, and bowls, and will mark the brand's fifth Los Angeles-area location.

Coastal Canteen, a new concept from the Jersey Shore Restaurant Group, is preparing to open at 142 Main Street in Manasquan with a coastal-inspired menu featuring shareables, handhelds, entrees, and a raw bar. An official opening date has not been announced.

Tigris is a Hi-Fi listening bar and café opening soon in Southwest Detroit. The venue will feature a custom sound system, vinyl library, guest DJ sets, and a Middle Eastern-inspired cocktail menu. By day it functions as a café; by night it transforms into a cocktail space.

The Daily Nosh is a scratch-made breakfast and lunch restaurant opening in a historic 1957 building in Downtown Roseville. The concept is co-owned by Randy and Lisa Peters and recently received liquor license approval. The restaurant is currently hiring staff ahead of its June opening.

data.status: hoping to open around September or October
data.short_description: G&B Hospitality has signed a lease for a new Patty & Press smashburger location in Bloomfield Township. Co-owners Goran Dimic and Brandon Gorgies are targeting a fall opening in a former Zoup! space. The restaurant will share the building with a FedEx Office Print & Ship Center.

data.status: does not have an estimated opening date yet
data.short_description: Culture Connects 707 is planning to add a coffee shop concept to its existing entertainment venue on Howard Street. The space would operate as a coffee shop by day and a comedy club by night. Owner James Simelton has applied for licensing and is awaiting approval before releasing more details.

data.location: 19300 Rinaldi St, Suite G, Porter Ranch, CA 91326
data.short_description: Hanasaki Sushi is expanding from Santa Clarita to Porter Ranch, taking over the former Sushi Ko space. The 1,700-square-foot location will feature an L-shaped sushi bar, dim lighting, and a red, black, and gray color scheme. The space still requires a full renovation before opening.

SoMa Social is a sports bar and restaurant that opened on May 15, 2026, in San Francisco's South of Market neighborhood. Created by Oxford Hotels & Resorts LLC, the venue offers breakfast, lunch, dinner, happy hour, sports viewing, and late-night drinks. The interior features vintage sports-inspired décor, wall-to-wall TVs, and a semi-private lounge called The Huddle Lounge.

Claude's Comedy Club & Bar is a new venue blending a diner, bar, and comedy showroom coming to South Broad Street in Philadelphia. Owner Reid Benditt describes it as a "diner meets bar" concept with shareable finger foods, cocktails, and an intimate showroom for stand-up comedy. No two-drink minimum is planned and ticket prices are intended to be accessible.

data.location: 461 S Capitol Ave #15, San Jose, CA 95127
data.short_description: La Grullensa, a family-owned Mexican restaurant in East San Jose open since 1991, is closing on May 25, 2026, with its final day of service on May 24. The team cited circumstances beyond its control as the reason for closure. The restaurant shared an emotional message on Instagram thanking the community for over 35 years of support.

PopUp Bagels is opening its second San Diego County location at 510 Vista Way in Oceanside, operated by local franchise partners Paul Goodman and Griffin Thall (The Bagel Boyz). The opening celebration is scheduled for May 22, 2026, from 8 a.m. to 11 a.m. The location will feature a limited-time Blackberry Jalapeño Crunch Schmear exclusive to San Diego locations.

Blue Collar, a comfort food restaurant in Miami's MiMo district founded in 2012 by Chef Daniel Serfer, officially closed on May 17, 2026, after its final dinner service. Chef Serfer announced the closure on Instagram on May 15, expressing gratitude for years of community support. No specific reason for the closure was shared.

data.status: welcoming a new concept this summer
data.short_description: Fiorenza Italian is an upcoming upscale-casual Italian restaurant coming to Alpharetta, brought by Florence-raised restaurateur Jessi Qilafi. The restaurant will feature Tuscan dishes and house-made pastas including Pappardelle al Ragu and Bistecca alla Fiorentina. No specific address or opening date was provided in the article.

data.location: Mitchell Street, Atlanta, GA (Address not specified)
data.status: opening date of the new location is yet to be announced
data.short_description: Dough In The Box Donuts is opening its fourth location on Mitchell Street in Atlanta as a grab-and-go express store. Owned by husband-and-wife team Jesus and Dannia Balestena, the new spot will serve coffee, donuts, croissants, and bagels. No specific address or opening date was provided in the article.

PITA Mediterranean Street Food is expanding to Roswell, Georgia, in a 1,200-square-foot space. No specific address or opening date was provided in the article. The article notes the chain is known for Mediterranean food.

The Southern Chef is planning its seventh location at 5307 East Highland Drive in Jonesboro, situated between Hytrol and the ABB factory. No opening timeline has been announced, though work still needs to be completed to convert the space. The chain serves a wide-ranging American menu including pizza, wings, and subs.

data.status: set to begin welcoming guests next month
data.short_description: Ovoka Farm, known for its F1 wagyu beef and agritourism programs, is opening a wine tasting room inside its historic manor home. The reservation-only experience will pair wagyu-focused cuisine with wines produced on the farm. No specific opening date was provided beyond "next month."

CHICHA San Chen, an internationally renowned Taiwanese tea house, is opening its second Massachusetts location at One Brattle Square in Harvard Square. Franchisee Andy Liao shared a preview on social media, describing the space as featuring soft textures, warm tones, and a calm atmosphere. No opening date has been announced.

data.location: 412 S Main, Memphis, TN (zip not specified)
data.short_description: The Artist Table, a chef residency and event space on South Main in Memphis, has closed its current location with plans to relocate. Founder Daishu McGriff announced the closure on social media, citing a need to preserve her peace, integrity, and the brand's dignity. A new location and timeline have not yet been announced.

data.status: slated to take over the Sbarro space
data.short_description: Andy's Pizza is set to take over the Sbarro space at Union Station in Washington, DC. No opening timeline is currently available, though the location is expected to include Andy's recently launched bagel program. The chain currently operates 14 locations across the DMV region.

data.status: official opening date has not yet been announced
data.short_description: Mesón is a new Spanish-inspired restaurant taking over the former Three One Four Pizzeria space at 1329 Gilman St in Berkeley. The concept is heavily inspired by the acclaimed Spanish tapas bar César, and will reunite several former César team members including former sous chef Juan Gomez. The menu will feature dishes such as patatas bravas, montaditos, and paellas.

data.status: preparing to open at the end of June
data.short_description: Fanoos Grills is opening a new San Francisco location at 411 Columbus Ave, bringing its grab-and-go Mediterranean shawarma concept to North Beach. Owner Adnan Alame indicated interest in future Bay Area expansion into markets such as San Jose, Santa Clara, and Hayward. The upcoming location follows the success of the brand's first San Francisco outpost.

data.status: closed; reopening projected around two years
data.short_description: Aviator's Restaurant at Sacramento Executive Airport has been closed since December 24 after a flooring project uncovered major structural issues including deteriorated rebar, mold, asbestos, and water intrusion. The full remodeling process is being managed by Sacramento County and the Department of Airports, with a reopening projection of approximately two years. Owner Cheung-Sang Chik noted the closure may provide an opportunity to make improvements to the space.

data.status: opening date has not been announced
data.short_description: Bongo Creamery Wynwood has filed permit applications to open a Häagen-Dazs location at 50 NW 24th Street in Miami's Wynwood neighborhood. No opening date has been announced. The article notes Häagen-Dazs operates more than 200 shops in the U.S. and approximately 400 locations worldwide.

data.location: 3715 S State Hwy 161, Grand Prairie, TX 75052
data.short_description: A new corporate-owned Black Bear Diner is set to begin construction on May 18 at a 4,800-square-foot space in Grand Prairie. The project is expected to be completed by December 15, 2026, and will be situated within one of Grand Prairie's fastest-growing commercial corridors.

data.status: set to debut later this year
data.short_description: Chef Mike Cordero is bringing an old-school Italian restaurant with a modern flair called Capellini's Classic Italian to a 3,500 sq ft space in Ashburn that previously housed Rebel Taco Cantina. The restaurant will seat up to 75 guests indoors and 80 al fresco, emphasizing Northern Italian dishes made from scratch.

data.location: 312 Grays Rd, Hamilton, ON L8E 1V5, Canada
data.short_description: Graze Craze, a charcuterie-focused franchise, is opening its first Ontario location in Stoney Creek on May 21, with a ribbon-cutting event expected to include Hamilton Mayor Andrea Horwath. The location is locally owned and operated by Danielle Parks, and marks a key milestone in the brand's broader Canadian expansion.

Popeyes is planning a new restaurant at 470 Washington St in Brighton as part of a 15-unit Greater Boston expansion led by franchisee Rahman Hashimi. The location will occupy roughly 1,727 square feet with seven customer seats; exact opening timelines have not yet been announced.

Amor y Magia, a Latin American-inspired restaurant from the team behind Same Same and Good Enough Cocktail Club, is set to open in Carlsbad in mid-June 2026. The concept blends Filipino, Venezuelan, Mexican, and broader Latin American culinary influences, with communal dining and a Gothic and Spanish Revival-inspired design.

Biscuit Belly, a Louisville-founded Southern-inspired "craft casual" chain, is opening its first Columbus location at 1417 W. 5th Ave on June 2, 2026, with opening celebrations beginning June 6. This will be the brand's 15th location, featuring a mural wall and a locally themed beverage.

Project LeanNation, a healthy meal and coaching brand, is making its Orlando debut at 12490 Lake Underhill Rd in a retail center near South Alafaya Trail. According to the brand's website, the Orlando location is planned to open in July 2026.

data.status: opening date has not been announced
data.short_description: Valisi Consultants Corp. filed permit applications to open a Diadem Pickleball Complex at 10570 W. Forest Hill Boulevard in Wellington, which will be the brand's second U.S. location. The complex will feature courts, a pro shop, and an in-house restaurant offering pizza, salads, beer, wine, and soft drinks.

A new 50's Diner is set to open at 7223 International Drive in Orlando's Dowdy Plaza, according to plan review documents submitted by 50's Diner LLC. The restaurant will offer dine-in service, curbside pickup, and delivery; further details remain scarce as the owner was not immediately available for comment.

data.status: expected to roll out over the next year and a half
data.short_description: Charcoal Group is planning a new Wildcraft Grill + Long Bar location in Burlington as part of a five-restaurant Ontario expansion totaling $25–$30 million CAD. Specific opening dates have not yet been announced.

data.short_description: Charcoal Group is planning a Beertown location in Peterborough as part of its five-restaurant Ontario expansion backed by $25–$30 million CAD. Specific opening dates have not yet been announced.

data.short_description: Charcoal Group is planning a Beertown location in Richmond Hill as part of its five-restaurant Ontario expansion. Specific opening dates have not yet been announced.

data.location: 2427 N Atlantic Ave #13, Daytona Beach, FL 32118
data.short_description: Plan review documents filed by Momagic 22 LLC indicate a new Wingstop is planned at 2427 N Atlantic Ave, Suite 13, in Daytona Beach. The franchisee behind the location was not immediately available for comment, and no opening date has been announced.

Frosti Ice Cream is opening soon at 606 N State Street in Bunnell, offering milkshakes, ice cream, Italian ice, coffee, iced tea, and dairy-free options, per co-owner Ashot Zatikyan. No specific opening date has been announced.

Pear Plum, an all-day cafe, specialty coffee shop, and wine bar, is set to open at 101 Island Ave in downtown San Diego in January 2027. Owners St. Elmo and Christina Crawford are bringing the concept to a space that has been vacant for three years, focusing on daytime cafe service transitioning into an evening wine destination.

data.location: 904 E Las Olas Blvd, Fort Lauderdale, FL 33301
data.short_description: The Restaurant People announced that Naia, a Mediterranean cuisine restaurant with Asian influences, will open in October 2026 at 904 E. Las Olas Boulevard in the former space of Mango's. The concept will feature a dynamic indoor-outdoor layout with a central bar, curated cocktails, premium wines, and shareable plates.

A Downtown Investment Authority committee voted 3-0 on April 30 to recommend moving forward on a proposal from Baltimore-based Atlas Restaurant Group to design, build, and lease a restaurant at Riverfront Plaza in Jacksonville. The concept is expected to be influenced by Atlas's Choptank restaurants, a classic fish and crab house concept based in Annapolis, Maryland.

data.status: opening date has not been announced
data.short_description: The owners of The Stand comedy club are planning a second location called The Stand West in the cellar level of Chelsea Market at 407 W 15th St, with a 140-person capacity. The venue will pursue a full liquor license and offer a small menu of Italian-influenced bar fare.

Thorough Bread Bakery & Cafe, a sourdough-focused bakery started during the pandemic by California-turned-Aiken baker Molly Newman, is expected to open at 115 Laurens St. later this fall. The bakery will occupy a historic building in downtown Aiken that was once an old Coca-Cola bottling plant.

data.location: 1636 Hendricks Avenue, Jacksonville, FL (zip not specified)
data.short_description: Hard Pressed Burgers, voted Best Food Truck by Folio Weekly in 2024, has opened its first brick-and-mortar restaurant at 1636 Hendricks Avenue in the San Marco neighborhood. Founders Justin Pa'ala and Eddie Evans are already exploring potential sites for additional locations.

Niko's Bar-N-Grill, owned by Christopher Ennis, will open at 10455 Rieger Rd. in Baton Rouge, with a liquor license recently approved by the city and hiring currently underway. No official opening date has been announced, though an Instagram post states "Grand opening coming soon."

data.status: preparing to expand…with a new location
data.short_description: Franchisees Jeff and Bob Phelps are preparing to open a second Jacksonville Jet's Pizza location at 5617 Beach Blvd, following the success of their first location at 11250 Old St Augustine Rd, which opened April 12, 2024. No opening date for the Beach Blvd location has been announced.

data.location: 1200 El Paseo de Saratoga, San Jose, CA 95129
data.short_description: Sweetgreen is opening a new Saratoga + Campbell location in West San Jose on May 19, 2026. The 2,406 sq. ft. restaurant will serve signature salads, warm bowls, and protein plates using locally sourced California produce. Preview events with complimentary meals were offered on May 15 and 16.

data.location: 1900 N. Highland Ave., Suite 6B, Los Angeles, CA 90068
data.short_description: Pita & Pie is seeking an ABC license at 1900 N. Highland Ave., Suite 6B in the Hollywood area. The concept is backed by Amer Nackoud, though little information about the menu, design, or opening timeline is currently available. No website or social media accounts have been created for the brand as of publication.

data.status: expected to open in late spring
data.short_description: Austin food truck Espadas de Brazil is opening a brick-and-mortar Brazilian steakhouse in Bastrop at 1507 Chestnut St., a space formerly occupied by Stem & Stone. Owner Robinson Figueiredo announced the new location on social media and has begun hiring for the space. The restaurant will serve authentic churrasco dishes including spicy garlic picanha and protein-centered plates.

Seaviche Tacos & Bowls has signed a lease for a third location at 32500 Gratiot Avenue in Roseville, joining existing locations in Detroit and White Lake. Owner Evan Shina does not have an opening date at this time. The Mexican seafood concept offers tacos, burritos, bowls, quesadillas, and family trays.

KP's Kitchen and Bar is closing its Bellaire location on May 31, with owner Kerry Pauly citing a desire to refocus energy on the original Spring Valley location. The restaurant was known for elevated American comfort food including double cheeseburgers and hot honey chicken sandwiches. The Spring Valley location will remain open.

data.status: plans pointing to a later 2026 opening
data.short_description: Jaggers, the burger-and-shake concept operated by Texas Roadhouse, is preparing to open at the former Twin Peaks space at 1915 Hampton Inn Court near Hanes Mall Boulevard in Winston-Salem. The opening adds to the chain's growing North Carolina presence, which already includes locations in Fayetteville, Greenville, and Jacksonville. Additional sites are also planned for Concord and Raleigh.

Ike's Café & Grill opened its newest location in Marietta with a ribbon-cutting, open house, and community celebration on May 8, 2026. The 3,200 sq. ft. full-service restaurant serves African-inspired cuisine including jollof rice, suya, and egusi soup, along with breakfast and specialty coffee. The Marietta location is the latest addition to the brand's expansion following a ghost kitchen concept launched in 2025.

data.event_date: May 13, 2026 (announced); closure date not specified beyond announcement
data.short_description: Harvey's Deli, a family-owned sandwich shop in Katy, Texas, announced its sudden closure on social media on May 13, 2026, after five years of business. Owners Tierra and Ted Tyman cited economic struggles and the extreme overhead of running a small business as the reasons for closure. The shop was known for East Coast-style sandwiches and in-house prepared meats.

Esther Rum, a women-owned premium spirits brand co-founded by Margaret Kerr-Jarrett and Emunah Winer, has recently launched in select locations across Columbus, Ohio. The Colombian-imported rum is bottled locally at Echo Spirits in Columbus and is designed to appeal to consumers who favor tequila or other sippable spirits. The brand features a distinctive bright green bottle cap designed to stand out on shelves.

Ted's Hot Dogs is opening a new Chandler location on May 23, 2026, featuring a retro-inspired design, outdoor patio seating, and the brand's first drive-thru. The two-day grand opening celebration will include giveaways, free hot dogs for the first 100 customers, and free ice cream from the walk-up window. Founded in Buffalo, New York in 1927, the fourth-generation family-owned chain is known for charcoal-grilled hot dogs and open-fire cooking.

data.location: 100 Corte Madera Town Center, Corte Madera, CA 94925
data.short_description: Vietnamese fast-casual chain Asian Box is set to open at 100 Corte Madera Town Center in Corte Madera this fall, per a recent Instagram post. Founded in 2011 by Chad Newton and chef Gracie Nguyen, the California-based chain offers 100% gluten-free, customizable Vietnamese-inspired street food made with fresh, sustainably sourced ingredients. Popular menu items include The Workout bowl and Chef Gracie's Grandma's Pho.

Ristobar, a 22-year-old Italian restaurant in San Francisco's Marina District, will close on May 25, 2026 (Memorial Day). The team shared no specific reason for closure, but noted the Chestnut Street space will continue as Eria Marina, a 5,300 sq. ft. indoor-outdoor events venue through a partnership with Eria Events. The restaurant was owned by pastry chef Gary Rulli and his wife Jeannie, who also operate the Emporio Rulli bakery in Larkspur.

data.status: ready to open (opening date not announced)
data.short_description: Sushi Kobashi, led by chef Gang Lin who was part of the Michelin Star-winning team at Yoshino, is set to open at 211 7th Ave. in Chelsea at the former Hana Sushi space. The eight-seat restaurant will specialize in an omakase experience starting at $250 per guest, with Chinese ingredients incorporated as a nod to Lin's heritage. A permit filing was submitted with Community Board 4, though no official opening date has been announced.

data.status: opening date has not been announced
data.short_description: The team behind gastropubs Grove Street Social and Grand Street Social is planning a new concept called Clake & Moore Kitchen and Bar at 201 8th Ave. in Chelsea, in the former Olde City Cheesesteaks & Brew space. The restaurant will feature elevated pub food, signature cocktails, wine and beer, with a 49-seat first-floor dining room and a second-floor private event space for up to 74 guests. A permit filing was submitted with Community Board 4, but no opening date has been announced.

data.location: 4400 Post Oak Park Dr, Houston, TX 77027
data.short_description: Mack Allen's is a new 16,000 sq. ft. fine-dining restaurant set to open in July 2026 as an anchor tenant at the 5POP office tower at 4400 Post Oak Hwy in Houston's River Oaks–Uptown area. The restaurant will feature a main dining room, three private dining spaces, and a botanical garden-inspired patio, with a New American menu highlighting prime beef, wagyu, and seafood. The concept is backed by oil and gas executive Mack McDonald, who also owns the Rouxpour restaurant collection.

Lou Malnati's South Loop location completed an approximately 2,400 sq. ft. expansion, bringing the restaurant to nearly 8,400+ sq. ft. total, while continuing regular operations throughout the process. The updated space added a new full-service bar, additional dining room seating, and a private events space accommodating up to 50 guests. Private event bookings are now open at the expanded location.

Stäge Kitchen & Bar is opening its second location at 110 Campus Way in Dunwoody, inside Campus 244's Element Hotel by Westin, after five years in Peachtree Corners. The globally inspired fusion restaurant features an omakase bar, cocktail program, and a menu from Executive Chef Charlie Sunyapong with dishes like duck fried rice, grilled Spanish octopus, and lamb lollipops. The restaurant is open daily, with hours varying by day of the week.

data.status: targeting a late-summer or early-fall opening
data.short_description: Churp, a new fast-casual healthy bowl concept from founder Tyler Helikson (also behind Happy + Hale), is preparing to open at Olde Raleigh Village on Edwards Mill Road. The restaurant will center on customizable bowls and will include a dedicated kids bento box-style menu. An exact opening date and full menu details have not yet been announced.

data.short_description: Gig's Gourmet Baked Potato is a new food truck and catering operation on Chicago's South Side, run by chef Gig McFadden after nearly 20 years in high-end kitchens. The truck specializes in gourmet loaded baked potatoes alongside comfort food staples, scratch-made sauces, and signature desserts, operating Tuesday through Saturday from 11 a.m. to 5 p.m. McFadden's long-term vision includes partnering with an investor to expand beyond the food truck.

The Florida-born rotisserie chicken chain was founded in 1992 and is known for chickens roasted over Brazilian oak logs.
